memory_floor_basis: 1.0 GB is DERIVED FROM THE CASE SIZE AND IS NOT MEASURED, unchanged from R1. The family is a 2D axisymmetric 5deg wedge at 4000 / 16000 / 64000 cells running scalarTransportFoam SERIAL (ranks 1); the momentum equation is not solved (the parabola is imposed). A single scalar field on at most 64000 cells is of order a few MB; a gigabyte is generous by orders of magnitude and is a scheduling floor, not a profiled footprint. It is an INFRASTRUCTURE field: a wrong value here is a bookkeeping defect that can misschedule the run and can NEVER produce NOT A RESULT (L-342).
